patch.value: GH-797: rank read/show/view recovery by executable intent and bounded contracts guidance

Align unknown-command recovery for read-shaped intents so pm read does not surface alphabetical command noise while show/view consistently resolve to get, and replace the oversized root-help fallback with the bounded contracts summary surface.

pm read, show, and view recover to executable read semantics with deterministic ranking; unknown-command recovery recommends bounded contracts summary guidance instead of root help; token and executable-alias regressions cover human and structured modes
Make mistaken read intents recover with minimal context cost
Agents reach the correct item read command without consuming the full help surface
Run pm read, pm show, and pm view for an item-shaped intent and compare suggestions and recovery guidance.
Read-shaped aliases and mistakes converge on pm get with a bounded discovery fallback.
pm read receives alphabetical noise while show/view resolve to get, and fallback guidance sends agents to the full root help payload.
A common read intent spends unnecessary tokens and can route automation toward unrelated commands.
